---
description: "Forms styles, style options, stylers, renderers, and the Platinum style"
---

- Forms styles and renderers group overview:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Api-Styling.h`
- Register and retrieve shared renderer facets for a Forms style:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Style.h`
- Configure global and widget-local visual style options:
  `include/Pt/Forms/StyleOptions.h`
- Bind widget-local style options to shared or custom renderers:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Styler.h`
- Implement reusable Forms renderer facets and reset themed drawing state:
  `include/Pt/Forms/Renderer.h`
- Use the built-in Platinum Forms style:
  `include/Pt/Forms/PlatinumStyle.h`
